[[Dwarven Miner]]s are mining ore for [[Budger Blackpowder]].

==Locations==
*[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Drakkar Lake}} (after completion of [[the Big Unfriendly Jotun]])

==Dialogue==
When Budger Blackpowder addresses them:
:''Just don't blow yourself up and put us out a job, Budger. It's a beast of a hike back to [[Droknar's Forge]].''

==Notes==
*Dwarven Miners do not fight and enemies do not target them.
*After being turned via interaction, a miner will continue mining even when facing away from the mountainside.
